title: Ding Dong Eat It Up
blurb: A chaotic little food chant with the exact energy of somebody dancing in front of an open fridge at midnight, illuminated only by the fridge. TikTok attached it to snacks, meals and general consumption of every kind, and it works because it commits fully to something that should be embarrassing. There is no irony in it at all, which is rarer than it sounds. Play it when food arrives, when the fridge starts calling from the other room, or when your self-control has clearly clocked off for the evening.
